bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
image=localhost/gace-stk04-pin:88fb602c
podman image exists "$image" || { echo STK04_VERIFIED_PIN_IMAGE_MISSING; exit 80; }
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_OWNER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 81; }
name="$names"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_NOT_RUNNING; exit 82; }
docker exec "$name" node --version >/dev/null || { echo STK04_GAYBBS_NODE_UNAVAILABLE; exit 83; }
result="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-stk04-onshot.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$result"' EXIT
if podman run --rm --entrypoint cat "$image" /app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs | docker exec -i "$name" node --input-type=module - >"$result" 2>&1; then
 grep -E '^STICKER_PIN_(OWNER|TARGET|TARGET_SOURCE|TELEGRAM_ACK|MESSAGE_ID|INDEPENDENT_READBACK)=' "$result" || true
 grep -q '^STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=YES$' "$result" || { echo STK04_PIN_API_ACK_NOT_PRESENT; exit 84; }
 echo STK04_PRODUCTION_TELEGRAM_PIN_ACK=PASS
else
 grep -E '^STICKER_PIN_(RESULT|ERROR)=' "$result" || true
 if grep -q 'STICKER_PIN_ERROR=STICKER_TOPIC_NOT_VERIFIED_OR_AMBIGUOUS' "$result"; then exit 85; fi
 if grep -q 'STICKER_PIN_ERROR=STICKER_PIN_DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED' "$result"; then exit 86; fi
 if grep -q 'STICKER_PIN_ERROR=STICKER_PIN_RECEIPT_NEEDS_RECONCILE' "$result"; then exit 87; fi
 echo STK04_PIN_EXECUTION_NOT_VERIFIED
 exit 88
fi
